display.purpose: Hero product name and section openers. One per viewport.

shadows.name: label
shadows.purpose: Lifts the hero label card off the page ground.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Stamp red ground, kraft text. The single dominant action per viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b23a2a; color: #faf6ee; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8f2e22; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b23a2a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent ground, 2px ink border. Inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #1c1a16; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid #1c1a16; border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #1c1a16; color: #f2ead9; }

components.name: Seal Button
components.description: Pill-shaped stamp red seal. Hero CTA only.
components.css: .ds-btn-seal { background: #b23a2a; color: #faf6ee; padding: 12px 24px; border: 2px solid #b23a2a; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-seal:hover { background: #8f2e22; }

components.name: Label Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid #1c1a16; border-radius: 2px; background: #faf6ee; color: #3a3530; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Kraft-light panel with 2px ink border. Lifts 2px on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #faf6ee; color: #1c1a16; border: 2px solid #1c1a16; border-radius: 2px; padding: 20px; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Work Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #3a3530; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: The whole company profile is a product package. A label you can read, a barcode you can scan, a box you can open. The category default - a gradient hero over a three-card grid - is refused outright. Transparency is the mechanism, and a package's label is the most honest surface in commerce.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft-cream ground with warm near-black ink; stamp red carries all primary actions and seals.
Square label corners (2px) with occasional die-cut notch; no rounded SaaS cards.
Mono labels (JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked) for SKU, batch, and metadata.
Archivo Black headlines set as product names, never as display fluff.
Hairline rules separate content instead of shadows.
Every section carries the same diagnostic labels so the eye cross-checks.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp red is used on at most one dominant action per viewport.

rules.name: The No Pure Black Rule
rules.body: Text and borders use warm ink (#1c1a16), never #000000.

rules.name: The Product Name Rule
rules.body: Headlines are set as product names with real weight, never as display fluff.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation appears only as a response to state.

dos: Do print the contents on the label: every section carries its SKU/batch code and eyebrow.
Do use stamp red for at most one dominant action per viewport.
Do separate sections with 2px ink rules, not whitespace alone.
Do set headlines as product names with real weight (Archivo Black).
Do mark anything not on hand as empty state honestly.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, or rounded SaaS cards.
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff).
Don't fabricate testimonials, client logos, or verified metrics.
Don't use more than one stamp-red button per viewport.
Don't hardcode services/portfolios/pages - they come from the Laravel API.
